major.summary: Cancel does not restore focus after the Publish trigger remounts.
major.evidence: The handler focuses a trigger ref while that trigger is still unmounted; React mounts it only after the state update.
major.impact: Keyboard focus can be lost when confirmation closes.
major.recommendation: Set a post-cancel focus flag and focus the remounted trigger in an effect; test the real two-render lifecycle.

verification_gaps.summary: Required recovery and source-pruning acceptance coverage remains missing.
verification_gaps.evidence: Repair 1 added only the cache-rollover case; exact recovery/lock/focus and pruned draft/published coordinator branches remain uncovered.
verification_gaps.impact: The focused suite does not establish the acceptance contract.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Add the named tests and refresh all evidence.

do_not_change: Keep GrowthReportsService.publishGrowthReport and its writer as the sole atomic first-publisher-wins boundary.
Keep publication recovery as an exact coordinate read; do not route it through build recovery's current-period fallback.
Keep publication internal-only: it must not build, regenerate, share, send, or externally expose reports.
